shots.name: glow-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Glow card: the Preset menu showing Neon Bloom, Amount 4, Threshold 0.85, Softness 0.6, Radius 70 px and a white Color swatch, beside a strip of the preview where the neon signs bloom
shots.caption: Glow with the Neon Bloom preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Amount: how bright. 3 — Threshold: what glows. 4 — Softness: how gently light joins in. 5 — Radius: how far it spreads. 6 — Color: the tint of the halo.

shots.name: sheen-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Sheen card: the Preset menu showing Golden Beam, Position 0.5, Angle -60 degrees, Width 0.16, Softness 0.7, Intensity 1.2, Highlights 0.6 and a golden Color swatch, beside a strip of the preview where a warm beam crosses the dancer
shots.caption: Sheen with the Golden Beam preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Position: where the band is. 3 — Angle: which way it travels. 4 — Width: how far the light reaches. 5 — Softness: how gently it fades. 6 — Intensity: how bright.
